Hi Jordan / Priya — thanks, and great questions. Below are concise answers; happy to expand on any item or hop on a call.

1) SOC 2: Redwood has a SOC 2 Type II report (security & availability) for 2025. We typically provide a redacted copy for procurement review (attached in Marissa's forwarded message). Full reports are available under NDA.

2) GDPR / HIPAA posture:
- GDPR: We support data subject rights workflows; customers can configure retention windows and export/deletion tooling. We provide DSR guidance and logs for compliance.
- HIPAA: Redwood supports HIPAA and will sign a BAA for eligible customers. For Hosted API customers, certain controls are available contractually; for Dedicated and Private deployments (VPC/on-prem) we offer stronger isolation and a standard BAA process. We'll coordinate legal on the BAA template.

3) Default retention and what is stored:
- Request/response payloads (full request and generated output): default retention = 90 days for Hosted. This is the default audit/diagnostic logging for troubleshooting/performance and is not used for model training.
- Request metadata and aggregated usage/metrics: retained up to 365 days for analytics and billing by default.
- Customer-configurable retention: For Dedicated and Private deployments we can set request/response retention as low as 7 days (configurable per tenant) and adjust metadata retention via configuration and contract.

4) Backups and deletion SLA (how deletion applies to backups):
- Backups/snapshots: periodic encrypted backups are taken (daily incremental, weekly full snapshots) and retained by default for 30 days in our standard Hosted offering. Backups are encrypted at rest and in transit; customer-managed keys (KMS/HSM) are supported for Dedicated/Private.
- Deletion SLA (standard): on validated deletion requests we perform a logical/soft delete within 48 hours (remove live copies and stop serving data). Hard deletion from backups follows the configured backup retention window (standard hosted = 30 days). In short, live data is removed quickly (48 hours) but backups are subject to the backup retention window unless a contractually agreed accelerated purge is put in place.
- Accelerated purge options: for enterprise/Dedicated customers we can negotiate an accelerated backup purge process (e.g., purge within X days) as part of the contract and perform targeted snapshot/skewed retention policies.

5) Audit logs / access logs:
- Admin/audit logs: retained 365 days by default for enterprise tiers; can be exported to your SIEM via secure streaming (Syslog/Splunk/Cloud logging) for longer-term retention under your control.

6) Encryption & key management:
- All customer data at rest is encrypted. For Dedicated/Private we support customer-managed keys (KMS/HSM). Backups follow the same encryption standards and can be managed by customer keys with Dedicated/Private.

7) Where data may be persisted (geography):
- Hosted: regionally isolated deployments available (US / EU / APAC); backup locations are within the selected region by default.

8) Additional notes on training / model usage:
- Redwood does not use customer-supplied prompt/response data to train public models. We have contractual controls and opt-outs for model training.
